title: share-account dividend row id 3 (0.01 MNT initiated) read back with its stored status 100
_note: share-dividend seam, STATUS READ-BACK. request.dividend_amount "0.01" is share-account-detail-raw.json dividends[0].amount, the exact decimal text the oracle stored; expect.dividend_amount_minor "1" is that value transcribed to integer minor units (2dp). request.dividend_status_id 100 and expect.dividend_status_stored 100 are dividends[0].status.id (shareAccountDividendStatusType.initiated, value "Dividend Initiated"): the SAME dividend row SH-02 grades by amount is read back here through the account aggregate's dividends list, so this vector pins the stored dividend status integer (never the label). A port that re-encodes the stored status as a contiguous Go iota ordinal (stored id / 100 = 1) goes red on this cell, as does one that drops the dividend row's amount.

provenance.note: transcribed from .softhouse/capture/shares/out/share-account-detail-raw.json (account id 3, dividends[0]): amount 0.01, status.id 100 (shareAccountDividendStatusType.initiated).
